$comment: The CLI gate. tsconfig.json claims no app files (an editor reaches them through tsconfig.bakery.json), so this names them, and extends it for everything else: the compiler options and the ambient declarations in its files. extends never carries references, so this program does not follow the chain either, which keeps the gate a plain tsc -p over exactly these files. orm/ is the one that matters most: it registers the typed schema, and without it every file here, the plugins' sources included, compiles against an untyped ORM.
